'''Wan''' was a member of the [[White Maw]] who along with White Maw Guard [[T'uu]] was ambushed inside the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' by [[Languss Tuno]] and the [[Voidhound]]. Both Wan and T'uu were killed during the fighting.<ref>{{TORcite|Trick or Treat|Hoth}}</ref>
